explication: Liferay DXP is a Java-based digital experience platform with a broad set of OSGi modules. The supplied tree and excerpts show selected product areas rather than the complete runtime: accessibility UI, account administration, batch tasks, commerce validation, archived Solr search, and a Kubernetes-oriented cloud operator. The graph preserves these distinct capabilities and only draws relationships visible in the excerpts or source index; unsampled module internals and most cross-platform wiring are not inferred.
